issues.description: Inconsistent return type for Stock.take(String): the problem statement UML specifies `take(String): int`, and the reference solution implements `public int take(String ingredient)` returning `-1` on failure, but the template defines `public boolean take(String ingredient)`. This mismatch blocks students from implementing SealSaloon.checkOrderReady() with the intended `-1` failure convention and causes confusion about the expected API.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the UML/spec and solution by changing `Stock.take(String)` in the template to `public int take(String ingredient)` and use the same convention as the solution (e.g., return -1 when the ingredient is missing or quantity < 1; otherwise decrement and return the new quantity). Update any starter-code call sites accordingly.
